name: Johann Christian Pfeiffer
notes:
Family History Centre: Refer to LDS film # 758374.  For the year 1815, page 35, record 42 this record has been photocopied, and basically interpreted by Henry Brodersen to say:
1)On Sept. 22, 1815 at 8 o'clock in the morning, the father Johann Christian Pfeiffer, 28 years of age, occupant of #3 Pryzanie, showed us a child of female gender which was born on Sept. 15, 1815 at 11 o'clock in the morning in house #3.
2)The mother is named as Beate Louise Busch(en), 22 years of age.
3)Witnesses were Martin Schultz, 25 years of #19 (looks like occupant of Zbiersk, new land), and Gottlieb Minke, or Miske, 21 years old, living at home #51, Zbiersk?.
Based on this information, I have changed the fathers name from "Christian Pfeiffer" to Johann Christian Pfeiffer and established his birth year at 1787.  In a likewise manner, I have established the birth year of Beata Louise Busch at 1793.
The copy of this record is filed in the red, Zelmer book under LDS.
